subject: general
question: How many Prime Ministers of India have been elected upto June 2022, who were also Chief Ministers of their respective states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **6 Prime Ministers** of India have served as Chief Ministers of their respective states up to June 2022.
 
• These Prime Ministers include **Morarji Desai, Charan Singh, V. P. Singh, P. V. Narasimha Rao, H. D. Deve Gowda, and Narendra Modi**.
 
• The experience gained as Chief Ministers often contributes to their governance style and policies at the national level.
 
• Having served at both state and national levels, these leaders bring a comprehensive understanding of the political landscape in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Morarji Desai** served as the Chief Minister of Bombay State before becoming the Prime Minister.
 
• **Charan Singh** was the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh before his tenure as Prime Minister.
 
• **V. P. Singh** held the position of Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh before becoming the Prime Minister.
 
• **P. V. Narasimha Rao** served as the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **H. D. Deve Gowda** was the Chief Minister of Karnataka before becoming the Prime Minister.
 
• **Narendra Modi** served as the Chief Minister of Gujarat before his tenure as Prime Minister.
 
• This diverse experience helps in addressing both state and national issues with a balanced perspective.
